level.title: B1 Intermediate Tamil
goals: Communicate complex ideas with level-appropriate accuracy.
Adapt spoken and written register to audience and purpose.
Interpret and produce Tamil with cultural and pragmatic awareness.

lessons.title: Explaining health experiences
lessons.learn: Connect events, reasons, obligations, and opinions in clear everyday Tamil. Apply this skill to health & doctor, choosing forms appropriate to age, relationship, and setting.

grammar.title: Explaining health experiences — structure and register
grammar.explain: Connect events, reasons, obligations, and opinions in clear everyday Tamil. Tamil is suffix-rich and normally verb-final; preserve case, agreement, tense, and politeness while linking clauses.
grammar.pattern: context + case-marked participants + qualified message + finite verb
mistakes: Do not translate English clause order mechanically or mix colloquial and formal endings without a register purpose.

practice.q: Translate in context: கண் மருத்துவர் (kaṇ maruttuvar)
Produce the complete Tamil model: I am not feeling well
Reformulate aloud in natural Tamil: My head aches

quiz.q: What does கண் மருத்துவர் (kaṇ maruttuvar) mean in this context?
quiz.why: Here கண் மருத்துவர் (kaṇ maruttuvar) means “eye doctor.”

quiz.q: What does குழந்தை மருத்துவர் (kuḻandai maruttuvar) mean in this context?
quiz.why: Here குழந்தை மருத்துவர் (kuḻandai maruttuvar) means “children's doctor.”

quiz.q: What does ஆம்புலன்ஸ் (āmbulans) mean in this context?
What does அவசர பிரிவு (avasara pirivu) mean in this context?
quiz.why: Here அவசர பிரிவு (avasara pirivu) means “emergency ward.”

quiz.q: What does வார்டு (vārḍu) mean in this context?

tasks.instruction: Match each Tamil term to its precise English meaning.
Translate while preserving tone and intent.
